entry.title: New: Resolution 268 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO HAWAI‘I JAPANESE CENTER FOR THE JAPANESE COMMUNITY ASSOCIATION OF HAWAI‘I’S 2023 BUNKA NO HI PROGRAM

Transfers $3,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 2)
